notes.title: Yours Truly's Graphical Changes new look!
notes.notes: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41656015/341125b140955e4fae5a297f9054c7dc648cf0b9.pngHey everyone! It's been 3 years and some change since I've started developing alone, as fun and challenging as it was it's time to prepare the game for it's release. I wanted to subtly change the look of the game and maximize the aesthetics, so I changed the shading from soft shade to cell shade. I hope you all think it's a good change. Thank you!
